remarks: This newly renovated one-bedroom apartment in downtown Stamford is the perfect blend of modern luxury and urban convenience. As you step inside, you're greeted by a bright, open layout that makes the most of the space. The living area is spacious, with large windows that let in an abundance of natural light, highlighting the sleek, contemporary finishes throughout. The kitchen is a standout feature, with elegant quartz countertops that provide a clean, polished look. Stainless steel appliances, including a fridge, oven, microwave, and dishwasher, add a touch of sophistication while offering top-of-the-line functionality. The modern cabinetry and ample storage space make the kitchen both stylish and practical for everyday living. The bedroom is cozy yet spacious enough to comfortably fit a queen-sized bed and additional furniture. The unit features three large closets-the primary with built-ins. The bathroom has been updated with chic fixtures and finishes, featuring a sleek shower and modern vanity. The comes w/1 assigned parking space. One of the best features of this apartment is its location. Just a short walk away, you'll find a wide variety of restaurants, coffee shops, and shopping options. Heat and hot water included in rent.
